scripts.e2e:real: npm run build && npm run build:bridge && node scripts/e2e-real.mjs
scripts.e2e:workflow-real: npm run build && npm run build:bridge && node scripts/e2e-workflow-real.mjs
scripts.e2e:stop-real: npm run build && npm run build:bridge && node scripts/e2e-stop-real.mjs
